title: HydroSink: gut hydrogen-sink genes across vertebrates — pipeline, results and manuscript
description: Pre-registered synthesis of public gut shotgun metagenomes testing whether gut fermentation architecture governs hydrogen-sink partitioning (acsB vs mcrA) across vertebrates. Contains the full pipeline (screening, read sampling, DIAMOND marker quantification), per-sample results with SHA-256 manifests, all analysis outputs, a marker specificity benchmark, reporting checklists and the manuscript draft. Code: MIT; data, figures and text: CC BY 4.0.
